summary_for_children: Surah Maryam tells of Zakariyya's prayer for a child, of Maryam and the birth of Isa, of Ibrahim speaking gently to his father, and of other prophets.
environment_concept: A quiet chamber (19:11), a tall palm in a remote place (19:23) with a stream below it (19:24) and ripe dates (19:25), and a mountain slope (19:52). No one is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Prayer chamber, lonely valley with one tall palm and a stream, family home, and a mountain slope.

areas.name: Prayer Chamber
areas.description: A quiet chamber; no one shown.

areas.description: A tall palm in a remote place.

areas.name: The Mount
areas.description: A mountain slope where Musa was called.

narration_plan: Narration is quiet and reverent; Maryam, Isa and all prophets are never shown or voiced.
learning_objectives: Retell Maryam's account from the ayahs
